# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities in CodeRelay privately through
[GitHub's vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/AymanAhsan/CodeRelay/security/advisories/new).
Please do not open a public issue or disclose the vulnerability until it has been investigated and
fixed.

Include what you found, the affected version or commit, and the steps to reproduce it. You should get
a reply within a week.

CodeRelay is built on [T3 Code](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code). If a vulnerability also affects
upstream T3 Code, report it to them as well, following their security policy.
